tools.name: illustrate_financing
tools.description: Illustrate a monthly note the way the finance page does. Pass price, down, aprPercent, and months. Returns the principal, the formula payment, and the rounded dollars the page shows. Arithmetic only. Not a credit offer, not a rate lock, and not a promise a lender will take the deal. Taxes, freight, a battery, and a doc fee are not included. This desk does not publish a rate. The page allows a price from 5000 to 80000, a down payment from 0 through the price, an APR from 0 to 24, and a term of 24, 36, 48, or 60 months. The page opens on 16500, 2000 down, 11 percent, and 36 months as an illustration, not a quoted rate.

price.description: Truck price in USD. The finance page runs from 5000 to 80000. Opening illustration: 16500.

down.description: Down payment in USD. The finance page allows 0 through the truck price. Opening illustration: 2000.

aprPercent.description: Illustrated APR. The finance page runs from 0 to 24. Not a rate from this desk. Opening illustration: 11.

months.description: Term in months. The finance page offers 24, 36, 48, or 60. Opening illustration: 36.

tools.name: screen_truck
tools.description: Screen a truck the way the sell page does. Starts from that class band in the autumn 2026 price book, adjusts for year, hours, grade, and whether the power is known, then returns a low, a point, and a high. A screen, not an appraisal and not a bid. Year on the form runs from 1998 to 2026. Grade is A, B, or C. Power is sound, unknown, or needs-work.

year.description: Model year. The seller screen allows 1998 to 2026.

hours.description: Hours on the meter. The seller screen allows 0 or more.

grade.description: A is cleared in writing. B is work ready. C names the defects and is priced as a project.

power.description: sound means the battery or engine is known and sound. unknown means not tested. needs-work means it needs work.

tools.name: list_price_bands
tools.description: List the autumn 2026 used forklift price bands from the price book. Observed US independent listing ranges. Not inventory and not offers. Optional fuel filter: LP, Electric, Diesel, or Mixed.

fuel.description: Optional fuel filter, the same filters as the price book.

tools.name: get_price_band
tools.description: One class from the price book, by id. Same band, capacity, and hours note as the book page. Not an offer.

tools.name: list_walkaround_checks
tools.description: The walk-around checks on the method page, in the same order. The desk uses these before an introduction. This is not the OSHA daily exam.

tools.name: desk_terms
tools.description: Published desk terms: what a buyer pays to ask, the ten free buyer files, the state seat, the seller introduction, how a fleet is quoted, and what grades A, B, and C mean. Returns only figures the site already states.

tools.name: list_request_choices
tools.description: Choices printed on the buyer request form, the dealer seat form, and the fleet form. The state names are options on the seat form. This tool does not submit a request.
